- Choose the HyperOS 4 glass style independently for the top and bottom bars
- Adjust the HyperOS 4 bottom bar width from 70% to 100% and minimum height from 54 to 88 dp, with your dimensions preserved when switching styles
- Keep glass toolbar buttons visible before scrolling and list content clear of the bottom bar

---

- 支持为顶栏和底栏分别选择 HyperOS 4 玻璃风格
- 支持将 HyperOS 4 底栏宽度调整为 70%～100%、最小高度调整为 54～88 dp，切换样式后保留尺寸设置
- 保持玻璃顶栏按钮在未滚动时可见，并为列表内容留足底栏空间
